Fix triage page dropdown selectors not functioning
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK2T53XATPSTVMRNGCHCX23W
Type:      task
Status:    pending
Priority:  2
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  The filter dropdown selectors on the /triage page are non-functional — selecting a value has no effect. Likely causes: (1) Svelte 5 event binding issue (onchange vs on:change), (2) reactive state not updating when select value changes, (3) select elements may be missing bind:value or change handlers. Investigate the triage page route (routes/triage/+page.svelte), check how filter state is managed and whether dropdown change events properly update the reactive filter state and re-filter the displayed items.
Spec ref:  @interactive-triage
Tags:      bug, web-ui
Created:   2026-03-07T00:11:31.113Z

─── Spec Context ───
Interactive Triage System
Type: feature
Implementation: implemented
Description:
  Persistent triage metadata system with interactive UI. Triage decisions
  (reasoning, evidence, actions) are stored as TriageRecords in
  project.triage.yaml, surviving inbox item deletion. Supports agent
  triage, user override, action execution, and context export for agent handoff.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: the kspec project has inbox items that need triage

    When: a user or agent initiates the triage workflow

    Then: triage decisions are recorded as persistent TriageRecords in
project.triage.yaml, surviving inbox item deletion

  [ac-2]
    Given: an agent triages an inbox item, a user overrides the decision,
the override is acted on, and the result is exported

    When: the export is generated

    Then: the full decision chain (agent recommendation, user override,
action outcome) is captured with attribution and timestamps
